Apni umar doston se gino, saalon se nahi. Zindagi muskurahaton se gino, aansuon se nahi.
Khushi asli hai.
Aazadi apne liye zanjeerein khud chunne ki taqat hai.
Khushi ki pehli shart ek nirdosh antahkaran hai.
Azadi bandhan mukt hona hai.
Independence hi happiness hai.
Khushi samay hai.
Khushi lakshya hai.
Khushi hamesha hai.
Azaadi tabhi milegi jab doosron ko doge.
Joy is baat ka ehsaas hai ki hum zinda hain.
Azadi nishpaksh hai.
Asli khushi andar se aati hai.
Azadi zameen hai.
Aazadi discussion, dissent aur debate ke anvil par banti hai.
Aazadi sabse bada inaam hai.
Azadi sabse bada mulya hai.
Main ghulam raja hone se behtar azaad bhikhari banna chahunga.
Azaadi sawal poochne ka haq hai.
Khushi aantarik azadi hai.
Insaan barabar hain; janam nahi gun fark banata hai.
Khushi kritagyata mein milti hai.
Anand bas achhe hone ki sthiti hai.
Sachhi khushi pane ka ek hi tareeqa hai, poora khulne ka risk lo.
Khushi ek itra hai jise doosron par chirke bina kuch aap par nahi lagta.
Khushi atma hai.
Sachhi khushi hum par zyada nirbhar karti hai.
